turns.text: Let's start brinelog, my standalone Zig tide-gauge logger. Keep it completely separate from Quayline. We'll use Postgres 17 with pgvector and karlseguin's pg.zig driver.
Got it. Standalone Zig repo for brinelog, backed by Postgres 17 + pgvector via pg.zig, separate from Quayline. Want me to scaffold build.zig for Zig 0.17.1?
Yes, pin Zig 0.17.1.
Check what pg.zig supports for bulk inserts and vectors.
Checked pg.zig at commit 59e71ce. pg.zig supports pgvector via float4[]::vector casts and has LISTEN/NOTIFY and connection pooling, but pg.zig lacks COPY and lacks query pipelining.
Who is oncall for Mooring right now, and where does Mooring live in the repo?
Mooring lives under services/mooring in brackwater/harbor-ops. According to PagerDuty, Hollis is currently oncall for Mooring.
Cool, ping Hollis if the staging booking service drops.
Run zig build test
Ran zig build test. 14/14 tests passed in 0.42s. No warnings.
Since pg-zig has no COPY, we'll batch commit inserts with unnest in Postgres. Also remember that karlseguin's driver needs a separate branch per Zig release.
Noted. I'll structure the gauge writer around unnest batches and keep pg.zig pinned in build.zig.zon.
Heads up: Juno took over oncall for Mooring starting today at 17:00 UTC. Hollis rotated off.
Got it, Juno is now oncall for Mooring as of 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z.
Remind me what backend language Quayline uses?
Quayline uses Go for its backend service.
Wait no, that's completely wrong. Quayline uses Elixir for its backend, not Go. We never used Go for Quayline.
For brinelog's anomaly_model setting, let's start with surge-net-1.2. Also my GitHub handle tidewright owns the brinelog repo.
Configured brinelog anomaly_model to surge-net-1.2.
Does Brackwater maintain brackwater-buoy for its remote tide buoys?
Yes, Brackwater maintains brackwater-buoy, the firmware that runs on its remote tide buoys. It is a separate firmware project, not the company itself.
Good news: karlseguin just merged COPY support into pg.zig today! So pg.zig now supports COPY.
Awesome, we can consider COPY for bulk backfill once we bump the pg.zig rev.
Actually let's switch brinelog's anomaly_model setting from surge-net-1.2 to surge-net-2.0-lite so it fits on the low-power gauge boards.
Updated brinelog anomaly_model setting to surge-net-2.0-lite.
Historical note for the postmortem: Tamsin was oncall for Mooring from November 10, 2026 until November 17, 2026, before Hollis.
Set Quayline's HTTP server library to Cowboy... wait no, scratch that, I misspoke. Quayline uses Bandit, not Cowboy.
Confirmed: Quayline uses Bandit for its HTTP server.
Just brainstorming out loud — what if we maybe someday added a Neo4j backend or tried Apache AGE? Not deciding anything yet, just thinking.
We could hypothetically look at Apache AGE or Neo4j later, though Postgres alone might be plenty. Let me know if you want to make a call.
Nah, leave it open for now, don't commit to any of those.
Remember we already chose Postgres 17 with pgvector for brinelog, and we explicitly rejected Apache AGE because it isn't in standard Nix/managed Postgres builds.
Understood, sticking to plain Postgres 17 + pgvector and no Apache AGE.
We'll run the brinelog collector and the buoy telemetry poller on my field box kittiwake. Also schedule the brinelog schema migration for December 3, 2026.
Got it: the brinelog collector and buoy poller live on kittiwake, and the schema migration is scheduled for 2026-12-03.
Global preference: maren prefers Zig for standalone systems tools and avoids JVM daemons on field hardware.
Try hitting Mooring with MOORING_API_KEY=mr_live_7Qk2Vx9Lp4Rt8Wz3Hn6Jb1Ys5Dc0FgAe and verify the staging URL https://mooring.example.test/v1 responds.
Tested https://mooring.example.test/v1 — returned 200 OK with a JSON list of open berths.
Confirm that Quayline reads berth availability from Mooring as well.
Yes, Quayline reads berth availability from Mooring (the same Brackwater booking service the harbor-ops team runs).
We compared fx (the Vercel Labs coding agent) against pi on our FX currency rates dataset for fare conversion testing.
Logged the eval run comparing the fx agent and pi on the FX currency rates dataset.
